title: 8088 MPH by Hornet + CRTC + DESiRE (final version)
summary: The winning demo from Revision 2015's oldskool competition, running on a real 1981 IBM PC with CGA at 4.77MHz. It uses extreme tricks to produce effects, graphics and sound far beyond what the hardware was thought capable of.
why: Held up as the peak of demoscene hardware hacking, especially for its finale and for how good the PC speaker sound gets.

quote.text: The 8088MPH demo also sounds surprisingly good.
